title: Package the bounded native collaboration workflow
scope: Independently review the implementation owner's collaboration-reference packaging change without modifying it.
acceptance: The workflow limits concurrent delegated agents to three and assigns one write owner per path.
Independent audit is read-only and cannot self-approve implementation work.
A fresh agent can resume from task, handoff, and evidence files without hidden conversation state.
The Plugin fixed allowlist packages and validates the reference without adding a daemon or model identifier.
